description: Manual / estimated operating-segment revenue overlays. Applied after Yahoo Finance populate because segment detail is not available from that API.

segments.notes: Starlink consumer, business, maritime, aviation, and government (Starshield). Primary cash-flow engine with recurring subscription revenue.
Commercial, NASA, and DoD launches (Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship). Many Falcon 9 flights are internal Starlink deployments, so external launch revenue is lower than total launch activity.
AI products, compute, and related activities (xAI-related, Grok, X, compute infrastructure). Heavily loss-making due to compute and development spend.
